**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`. It set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. The 20-slot pool pinned at 20 in use. Every request then failed with `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

Impact began 02:14:18Z. It was still open at 03:59:27Z. 530 requests failed on node-3. Workers were untouched.

Roll back `dep-4471`. Restore `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.

Next: pull node-1 and node-2 logs to confirm scope.
